concept:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE exquisitely art-directed desktop website mockup for the Ask Sonar section of a premium social-listening landing page. The direction is "A closer look at the feed": a COMPACT photographic still life of two real female hands, a smartphone and an optical magnifying lens. NO large person or portrait outside the phone. NO men. NO headphones. NO paper, boards or newspapers. This must feel like a beautifully photographed object composition for a design-led brand, not stock photography or a generic AI interface.

SCALE IS CRITICAL: show the section WITH surrounding page whitespace so we can judge realistic web scale. Landscape canvas around 1536 by 1000. Warm off-white full page. At the top a quiet slim header with small "sonar." wordmark left and tiny Product / Pricing / Sign in links right. Then about 70px of white breathing room. The Ask section is a wide SOFT SEA-GLASS panel with a subtle 24px corner radius, roughly x70..1466 and y170..760: about 590px high, not a giant full-height hero. After this panel, leave generous off-white space with a small next-section eyebrow "THE PRODUCT" and the beginning of "One index, four ways in" near the bottom. Beautiful measured margins.

Inside the Ask panel:
LEFT half, calm and uncluttered. Tiny upper-case eyebrow "ASK SONAR". Big but controlled contemporary bold ink-teal typography, approximately 64px visual size, left aligned:
"Go beyond
the scroll."
A short delicate coral underline under "scroll."
Below in restrained 18px type:
"Ask about your market.
See the videos behind the answer."
Below that, an elegant normal-sized ivory input, width around 470px, height around 70px. Placeholder "Enter your niche or brand" and a small dark-teal circular arrow button. Under it, tiny TikTok and Instagram chips. The input and copy are real readable UI with generous spacing, not gigantic.

RIGHT half: a beautifully staged, small-ish photographic cut-out still life occupying only about 430px wide and 350px high, centered vertically in the right half. It must have plenty of clear air around it and NEVER dominate the entire section. The main phone itself is about 260px tall in this mockup. One realistic female hand with warm brown skin emerges elegantly from the lower-left edge of the still life and holds a thin dark-teal smartphone vertically at a slight diagonal. The phone displays an authentic photographic short-form video of a female skincare creator holding an unbranded cream serum bottle; she is small and entirely contained INSIDE the screen. Real phone glass, subtle reflections, tiny interface details, no garbled blocks of text or fake metrics.
A second realistic female hand with natural nude nails enters from the lower-right, delicately holding a beautiful round optical magnifying lens with a dark-teal metal rim. The lens is positioned just in front of the serum bottle area on the phone, revealing a slightly larger, beautifully sharp version of that product detail. Do NOT enlarge or distort the woman's face. This is an elegant literal metaphor for inspecting the content behind an answer. The lens is roughly 105px diameter in the full-page mockup, not huge.
Behind the main phone, only TWO small narrow portrait video glimpses, like exquisitely thin photographic glass slides, form a restrained fan at slightly different depths: one female fitness creator and one close-up of female hands demonstrating a product. They are each smaller than the phone, largely overlapped and softened by depth of field. These should read as a small collection of real social clips, not floating dashboard cards. No text labels or metrics on them.
Soft photographic shadows, subtle warm sunlight through the lens, beautiful tiny reflective highlights on glass and brushed metal. The hands are graceful but anatomically real with five fingers each. The whole still life emerges from a very gentle pale sea-glass / ivory cloud haze at its base; clouds must remain low contrast and elegant. The page layout stays crisp and understated.

Color discipline: warm ivory #f8f7ef, pale sea-glass #e4efea, very dark ink-teal #12383c, a SINGLE restrained coral accent. Ultra-real photographic skin and glass. Luxurious editorial product photography, real depth, extraordinary material detail, lightly grained atmosphere. No room, no table, no props beyond the hands, phone, optical lens and two small video glimpses. No big faces, no fashion model filling the page, no gimmicky neon, no holograms, no sonar rings, no futuristic HUD, no decorative squiggles, no extra CTA cards.
The result must feel thoughtfully designed, compact, cinematic and directly relevant to marketers researching social content. Precise typography and scale.
storyboard:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Create ONE polished six-panel photographic motion storyboard for the compact hands-and-phone Sonar visual in the attached website concept. Preserve the exact two realistic warm-brown female hands with nude nails, the slim dark-teal smartphone, the dark-teal rimmed real optical magnifying glass, the female skincare creator and cream serum bottle on the phone, and the two small blurred portrait video glimpses behind. All humans visible on phone/screens are female. NO men. NO large person outside a screen. NO paper, no boards, no headphones.

This storyboard explains a quiet 8-second animation suitable for a modest decorative area beside the Ask Sonar input. It should feel like high-end practical object photography. The phone remains steady in the left hand while the right hand moves the real lens in one graceful arc to inspect a detail in the video. The physical lens movement is the main animation. The creator video plays gently inside the phone; no speaking mouth needed. The two rear video glimpses shift only a few pixels in depth. Clouds drift very subtly. No big swoosh, no spinning phone, no busy UI, no sci-fi scanner, no fake analytics.

Layout: warm ivory editorial contact sheet, 3 columns by 2 rows, equal photographic panels, plenty of clean gutters and fine dark-teal caption type. Small title "A CLOSER LOOK AT THE FEED". Subtitle "Proposed 8-second motion". Each panel shows only the COMPACT still life at a consistent scale with generous pale sea-glass breathing room around it. Do not replicate the whole website six times. Keep the two hands and phone within the frame at all times, matching lens, skin, glass, lighting and anatomy between panels.

Six panels in this exact reading order, with these captions in the margin BELOW each panel:
1. "01 / THE FEED — 0s"
The left hand holds the phone steady, displaying the female creator with her cream serum bottle. The two little video glimpses are softly fanned behind. The right hand holds the optical lens BELOW and to the RIGHT of the phone, not covering the screen yet. Pale clouds below.
2. "02 / SOMETHING TO NOTICE — 1.5s"
The on-screen female creator gently brings the bottle a little closer within her video. The phone and hand remain steady. The right hand begins raising the magnifying lens toward the lower-right region of the phone. Clearly show the lens between its low starting place and the phone.
3. "03 / A CLOSER LOOK — 3s"
The right hand moves the lens over the serum bottle area of the phone. The lens crosses the screen with physically plausible optics. It magnifies the bottle and its texture, NEVER distorts or enlarges the woman's face. The glass receives a delicate warm reflected highlight. The two small rear videos recede just a little in focus.
4. "04 / THE DETAIL IS CLEAR — 4.5s"
The lens settles neatly over the bottle. The product detail is sharp and slightly larger inside the glass, completely aligned with the bottle in the phone beneath it. A calm intentional hold, almost exactly like the attached concept. The hands are still and graceful. No caption or graphic is pasted over the phone.
5. "05 / LET IT LAND — 6s"
The same detail stays in focus for a moment, with only a subtle natural wrist settling and a soft daylight glint traveling across the lens rim. The creator's natural blink or slight hand motion is confined to the phone video. The main still-life camera and phone do not move.
6. "06 / RETURN TO THE FEED — 8s"
The right hand lowers the lens back to the EXACT below-right starting position from panel 1, with the same phone, screen composition and fanned video glimpses so the next loop can begin seamlessly. The clouds remain pale and soothing.

The six images must make the real lens path visually obvious: LOW OUTSIDE PHONE -> RISING -> OVER PRODUCT -> FOCUS HOLD -> SHORT HOLD -> SAME LOW POSITION. Preserve realistic reflected light, contact of fingers on objects, natural wrist joints and exactly five fingers. No duplicated hands or floating extra products. Professional cinematic photographic quality and beautiful restrained composition. Precise readable captions. The imagery should be compact, tactile, relevant to researching social videos, and much more subtle than a giant human portrait.
